browser.diagnosticScope: Fixed error-category observer; no debugger. GUI wall time only, not isolated proof performance.
browser.failure: Browser post failed or timed out; raw provider/browser errors intentionally omitted.
browser.scope: Actual GUI post from preseeded disposable funded wallet; parent must verify canonical node effects. Not a full deposit-to-withdraw journey.

worker.profile: application transaction proofs with official local protocol fixture and controlled settlement

clientMining.clockSynchronization: every mined block, including correction of wall-clock lead

claim.scope: local real deposit and genuine private claim with ordinary checkpoint inclusion

replay.stage: PXE witness generation; no second proof accepted or transaction sent

claim.nextRequired: Wait eligibility; prove/include no-post exit, then use official test Outbox settlement and withdraw L1.

feeExhaustion.stage: actual private balance preparation; no proof or submission
